name: io.github.Jascenn/lingyi-tools-mcp
title: LingYi Tools
description: Search 171 AI tools in the LingYi Tools directory by keyword, category, pricing, or featured picks.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the LingYi Tools AI directory (bilingual zh/en) by keyword, category, or pricing. Featured tools are ranked first.

query.description: Keyword matched against name, descriptions and tags (zh + en)

category.description: Category id, e.g. chatbot, imageGeneration, codeAssistant

pricing.description: Pricing filter, e.g. free, freemium, paid

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full entry of one tool by id or name, including zh/en description, tags, and detail page links.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 16 tool categories with tool counts in each.

tools.name: list_featured
tools.description: List featured tools from the LingYi Tools directory.

tools.name: latest_tools
tools.description: List the latest tools by listing date (falls back to id order when no date is set).
